title: clompanus lurida
intro: Clompanus lurida, commonly known as the "Australian Finger Lime", is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its unique citrus flavor and is used as a food ingredient, particularly in high-end culinary applications. The health benefits of Clompanus lurida include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, limonoids, and other organic acids, but further research is required to fully elucidate its therapeutic potential.
